Name: PPJA - Starbrew Valley_A Collection of New Alcoholic Drinks
Author: paradigmnomad
Description:
[left][img]https://i.imgur.com/KuccdOC.png[/img]﻿
[size=3]
Ever wondered how Gus manages to stay open? Yeah, me too. Pam and Shane can't be spending that much and you have crops to attend to. Introducing Starbrew Valley ~ Now the Stardrop Saloon is an actual bar.
[/size]
Check out a companion mod made by spacechase0 - [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2054]More Rings[/url]﻿ to help negate the booze effects

[img]https://i.imgur.com/rL96BeA.png[/img]

- ChefRude
- Rjenyawd
- ParadigmNomad

Thank you for helping to sprite some of the drinks from our long list!

If you would like to contribute to the project, we welcome pull requests on our [url=https://github.com/paradigmnomad/PPJA]Github repo[/url]﻿!  You may also submit ideas or translations there.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/LKwk9jp.png[/img]﻿

- Balancing is an issue, but I have done my best for version 1.0.0
- JA does not support the named 'Tipsy' buff but rather Speed -1. All alcoholic drinks give a minimum debuff of Speed -1

[img]https://i.imgur.com/cVevYNe.png[/img]﻿

﻿See MouseyPounds database!
﻿
[url=https://mouseypounds.github.io/ppja-ref/index.html]L I N K[/url]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/Eqdpuvd.png[/img]

﻿﻿- Latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1720]Json Assets[/url]
- Latest version of [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Installing_SMAPI]SMAPI[/url]
- Latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1348]SpaceCore[/url]
- Latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1536]Mail Framework Mod[/url] (optional, to get seeds/recipes in the mail)[url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Installing_SMAPI][/url]
- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1926]Artisan Valley[/url]﻿ + all dependencies

Optional

- Latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5721]Champagne Wishes[/url]﻿ (for 3 recipes)
- Latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5342]Fizzy Drinks[/url]﻿ (for 2 recipes)
- Latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6293]Custom Crafting Stations[/url]﻿ (for use with the optional Cocktail Bar)
﻿
[img]https://i.imgur.com/kLbxt2U.png[/img]﻿
﻿
Step 1. Install SMAPI, Json Assets, SpaceCore, Artisan Valley (+ dependencies), and Mail Framework Mod (optional).
Step 2. Download this mod and extract the zip file anywhere you would like. There are 2 files included in the main download:

[JA] Starbrew Valley
[MFM] Starbrew Valley

Step 3. Drag & Drop the extracted folder(s) directly into the /Mods folder.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/MnkF0nq.png[/img]﻿

- Delete every existing food item made from this mod
- Remove the corresponding folder(s) inside /Mods
﻿
[color=#ff7700][b]If you miss any (especially in your inventory) you can crash your game.[/b][/color][/left]
